zzz:Phoenix.title: Phoenix Reffaella · S-Rank · Fire Anomaly
text: Phoenix was first mentioned at the climax of the Version 2.8 main story. Players finally met her in 3.2, in a comic scene that stayed with a lot of players.

Version 3.3, "Journey to the Sky", puts her at the centre of the main story. She travels with Severian, Seth Lowell's brother from Public Security, to the occupied skyport on Quietude Isle, and the two end up on opposite sides.

wuwa:Suoming.title: Seal Master of the Ten Seals Covenant · 5★ Electro · Sword
text: Suoming first appeared at the end of the Version 3.6 main story. Yinlin had just subdued the Takgyun Hall gang when Suoming stepped out behind her with a cryptic message.
She is the Seal Master of Mengzhou, the region Version 3.5 opened. She became playable in Phase II of 3.7 through the "Nine Deaths, One Unbent Heart" banner, with Unspoken Rue as her signature sword.

endfield:Si.title: Feranmut Proxy
text: Si had been teased since Version 1.2 before she was finally named. She arrives offering to treat the Endministrator and takes them to Yuanyuan Manor, a world she painted into being herself.
In battle she is a support who also deals her own damage. The rest of her story comes in a separate operator story.

nte:Akane Rin.title: S-Class · guitarist and lead vocalist of The Whoots!!!!
text: Akane Rin first appeared in the side story "A Legendary(?) Band's First Page" at the StarSign live house. She plays guitar and sings lead for The Whoots!!!!, and in battle her electric guitar is her weapon.

She became playable with NTE's half-year anniversary on October 21. In the new school-festival story the band plays a cover of "God Knows..." at Clement Academy's 100th-anniversary concert. Her Japanese voice is Ikumi Hasegawa.

genshin:Skirk.title: Childe's master · Cryo · Sword
text: Skirk is the swordswoman who taught Tartaglia to survive when he fell into the Abyss as a child. She is a disciple of Surtalogi, one of the Five Sinners of Khaenri'ah, but has never sided with the Abyss Order.
She first became playable in Version 5.7 (June 2025). October's banner was her rerun.

hsr:Mortenax Blade.title: Blade, reborn · 5★ Fire · Nihility
text: Mortenax Blade is a new form of the Stellaron Hunter Blade, the swordsman long afflicted by mara. He debuted with Version 4.3, "The Lethe Below the Living" (June 2026), the next chapter of the Planarcadia story.
In that story he and the Trailblazer take separate roads into the World in Canvas, and both lead to the shadow of Lord Ravager Asat Pramad. October's banner was his rerun.
